title: Creamy Fettuccine with British Shepherds Pie Twist
description: A unique fusion of Chinese and British flavors, combining the classic comfort of shepherds pie with the elegance of creamy fettuccine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook fettuccine according to package instructions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water before draining.
In a large skillet, cook bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add Shepherds Pie Mix and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer. Let cook for 2-3 minutes or until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add cooked fettuccine to the skillet and toss with the sauce. If the sauce seems too thick, add some reserved pasta water.
Season with soy sauce and stir in cheddar cheese until melted.
Serve hot, topped with crispy bacon and additional cheese if desired.
